page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 burstable instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs, which correspond to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading, and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reflect its burstable CPU allocation. Single-core performance is limited, with Geekbench single-core (884.0) and stress-ng single-core CPU tests falling into the bottom 10% of tested servers. However, multi-core capabilities scale to average levels when credits allow, as demonstrated by a Passmark CPU score of 9221.03 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 8341.23. Memory bandwidth remains stable, with uncached large block reads at 58.95 GB/sec and writes at 48.23 GB/sec.

This instance is designed for budget-conscious deployments where workloads experience intermittent spikes rather than sustained high CPU utilization. It is well-suited for static web serving, where it achieves a throughput of 6.57 GB/sec, and lightweight database operations. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, and the burstable CPU model makes it less suitable for continuous high-compute tasks like intensive software compilation or large-scale LLM inference.
